description: This source file defines an enum 'NodeDisplayName' which provides utility functions for managing device display names based on device type and interface idioms, including normalization and default naming logic.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if a given name is one of the generic device names.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns a default device name based on the interface idiom.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the display name for a device, considering existing names, device name, and interface idiom, providing fallbacks.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Attempts to normalize a device name if it contains certain substrings indicating an iPhone, iPad, or iOS device.
